description: AbstractAuthProvider.php defines an abstract base class for authentication providers within the OrangeHRM system. It specifies the methods that concrete subclasses must implement for user authentication and priority handling.

classes.name: AbstractAuthProvider
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for authentication providers, requiring implementation of authenticate() and getPriority() methods.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Abstract method to authenticate a user based on provided authentication parameters.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Abstract method to return the priority of the authentication provider.
